A swift and nimble raider, the Cutter is built for speed, not slugfests. While its light frame carries no broadside cannons, a skilled captain can slip past enemy defenses and strike where it hurts most—the vulnerable stern. Perfect for hit-and-run tactics, smuggling, or outmaneuvering heavier ships... just don’t get caught in a fair fight.
